006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Map;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Represents a container of rules constraining the effective model of a
017 * Metaschema field or flag data instance.
018 */
019public interface IValueConstrained {
020  /**
021   * Get information about the resource the constraints were loaded from.
022   *
023   * @return the source information
024   */
025  @NonNull
026  ISource getSource();
027
028  /**
029   * Retrieve the ordered collection of constraints.
030   *
031   * @return the constraints or an empty list
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  List<? extends IConstraint> getConstraints();
035
036  /**
037   * Get the collection of let expressions, if any.
038   *
039   * @return the constraints or an empty list
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  Map<IEnhancedQName, ILet> getLetExpressions();
043
044  /**
045   * Get the collection of allowed value constraints, if any.
046   *
047   * @return the constraints or an empty list
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  List<? extends IAllowedValuesConstraint> getAllowedValuesConstraints();
051
052  /**
053   * Get the collection of matches constraints, if any.
054   *
055   * @return the constraints or an empty list
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  List<? extends IMatchesConstraint> getMatchesConstraints();
059
060  /**
061   * Get the collection of index key reference constraints, if any.
062   *
063   * @return the constraints or an empty list
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  List<? extends IIndexHasKeyConstraint> getIndexHasKeyConstraints();
067
068  /**
069   * Get the collection of expect constraints, if any.
070   *
071   * @return the constraints or an empty list
072   */
073  @NonNull
074  List<? extends IExpectConstraint> getExpectConstraints();
075
076  /**
077   * Get the collection of report constraints, if any.
078   *
079   * @return the constraints or an empty list
080   */
081  @NonNull
082  List<? extends IReportConstraint> getReportConstraints();
083
084  /**
085   * Add a new let expression.
086   *
087   * @param let
088   *          the let statement to add
089   * @return the original let with the same name or {@code null} if no let existed
090   *         with the same name
091   */
092  ILet addLetExpression(@NonNull ILet let);
093
094  /**
095   * Add a new constraint.
096   *
097   * @param constraint
098   *          the constraint to add
099   */
100  void addConstraint(@NonNull IAllowedValuesConstraint constraint);
101
102  /**
103   * Add a new constraint.
104   *
105   * @param constraint
106   *          the constraint to add
107   */
108  void addConstraint(@NonNull IMatchesConstraint constraint);
109
110  /**
111   * Add a new constraint.
112   *
113   * @param constraint
114   *          the constraint to add
115   */
116  void addConstraint(@NonNull IIndexHasKeyConstraint constraint);
117
118  /**
119   * Add a new constraint.
120   *
121   * @param constraint
122   *          the constraint to add
123   */
124  void addConstraint(@NonNull IExpectConstraint constraint);
125
126  /**
127   * Add a new constraint.
128   *
129   * @param constraint
130   *          the constraint to add
131   */
132  void addConstraint(@NonNull IReportConstraint constraint);
133}
